_ground: 2026-08-05 static read. Stock conservation is this page's whole verdict: inventory_items + inventory_transactions is a parts LEDGER, and parts_staged_reservations adds an on-hand-vs-available split.

seen.ref: PDDA Y1b measured baseline: logbook/inventory/pm-scheduler route writes through a queue

invariants.name: qty_on_hand equals the newest transaction's qty_after

seen.ref: inventory-validator skill (ARC DI 10.5 balance<->ledger seesaw) + inventory.html:2061-2071

invariants.oracle: a part's qty_on_hand equals the NEWEST inventory_transactions.qty_after, and every qty change goes through inventory_deduct/inventory_restock leaving a transaction row - the one-sided-ledger-write class, in parts instead of pesos

invariants.name: no silent negative stock
invariants.oracle: a part cannot go below zero silently - a would-be-negative write is refused or lands in an explicit backorder state

invariants.name: two concurrent takes of the last unit cannot double-spend
invariants.oracle: two concurrent consumptions of the last unit: one succeeds, one is refused with a reason; the total never double-spends

invariants.name: staged reservations release on close/cancel
invariants.oracle: a staged reservation is released when its job closes or cancels - no orphan holds

invariants.name: every movement leaves an attributed transaction row
invariants.oracle: every stock movement leaves an inventory_transactions row naming who and why - a quantity change with no transaction row is a defect

invariants.name: foreign hive parts invisible end to end
invariants.oracle: a foreign hive's parts are invisible through the view, the RPC and the realtime channel - end to end, not merely the base table

domain_truths.name: low-stock triggers at the reorder point
domain_truths.oracle: the low-stock badge triggers at the part's reorder point, not a hardcoded threshold, and says which point it crossed

domain_truths.name: lead time is stated where reorder is suggested
domain_truths.oracle: lead time is stated wherever a reorder is suggested - a reorder point without lead time is half a recommendation

domain_truths.name: unit of measure travels with every quantity
domain_truths.oracle: the unit of measure travels with every quantity (pcs vs metres vs litres) - a bare number is the units_declared class

domain_truths.name: unit cost and total value are distinguished
domain_truths.oracle: unit cost and total value are distinguishable and neither is presented as the other

domain_truths.name: logbook consumption decrements the named part
domain_truths.oracle: a consumption recorded from a logbook entry decrements the same part the entry names

domain_truths.name: criticality drives the reorder policy, stated
domain_truths.oracle: a part's criticality drives its reorder policy and the surface states which

domain_truths.name: on-hand and available are two labelled numbers
domain_truths.oracle: stock-on-hand and available (on-hand minus staged reservations) are two numbers, both labelled

domain_truths.name: no movement reads as no movement
domain_truths.oracle: a part with no movement in the window says so, rather than rendering a stale 'last used' as current
